name: @sumirati/mcp-github

tools.name: github_find_actions
tools.description: Search and discover available GitHub actions in the 75-action catalog by keyword query or domain filter. Use this discovery tool first whenever you need to perform an action outside the 3 eager daily drivers (e.g. managing PRs, issues, releases, workflows, collaborators, webhooks, variables, security alerts). Returns matching action names, domain categories, mutating flags, descriptions, and complete parameter schemas so you can construct the call for github_execute_action.

query.description: Search keyword query to match against action names, domains, or descriptions (e.g. 'pull request', 'issue comment', 'webhook', 'deploy', 'dependabot')

domain.description: Optional domain filter to restrict discovery to a specific functional category

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default, structured object) or 'markdown' (compact human/LLM-readable text table)

tools.name: github_execute_action
tools.description: Execute any supported GitHub action from the 75-action catalog by action name with parameters. Requires the exact action name (discovered via github_find_actions) and its corresponding argument dictionary. Output is automatically compressed with strict token projection filters (stripping URLs, avatar links, empty hashes, node_ids) to guarantee 70%+ token savings. Mutating actions are blocked when running in read-only mode (GITHUB_READ_ONLY=true).

action.description: Exact name of the GitHub action to execute (e.g. 'create_pull_request', 'list_issues', 'trigger_workflow', 'create_branch')

params.description: Parameters dictionary for the action matching its parameter schema

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Read current file contents or list directory entries from a repository at a specified git ref without cloning. Automatically decodes Base64 file contents into plain text UTF-8 in 'decoded_content'. Eager daily driver tool for inspecting source code, configuration files, and directory layouts.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

path.description: Relative path to file or directory in repository (e.g. 'README.md', 'src/index.js', or '' for root)

ref.description: Git reference (branch name, tag, or commit SHA) to read from (default: default branch / HEAD)

tools.name: get_repository
tools.description: Get comprehensive repository metadata, visibility, description, default branch, clone URLs, star count, and topics for an owner/repo. Eager daily driver tool for verifying repository configuration and existence.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get detailed commit metadata, author information, message, and unified git diffs for a specific commit SHA or reference. Eager daily driver tool for reviewing code modifications, patches, or investigating regressions. Output diffs are token-optimized and automatically truncated to max_diff_lines (default: 400 lines).

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization, e.g. 'octocat' or 'buggycode')

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag reference to inspect

file_path.description: Optional file path filter: only include diff and stats for this single file

max_diff_lines.description: Maximum unified diff lines to return across files to conserve LLM context tokens (default: 400)
